theorem prop_5_2_4_c {α x δ U' W' W : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hx : 0 < x) (hW : 0 < W)
    (hδ0 : δ ≠ 0) (hcond : x / (4 * W) + q ≤ x / (|δ| * q)) (hU' : x / (2 * W) ≤ U')
    (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    (S2 α x U' W' W ≤ (W - W' + x / (|δ| * q)) * logSqSum W' W) ∧
    (∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ W' → R ^ 2 ≤ x / (|δ| * q) / (q + x / (4 * W)) →
      Nat.totient q / q * Real.log R * S2 α x U' W' W ≤
        (W - W' + x / (|δ| * q)) * logSqSum W' W) :=

note: Lean's suffixes are out of order (a, e, b, c, d); (5.54) adds W ≥ 50000 and (5.56) is split into a trivial branch and a log R gain with R ≤ W′. Erratum: The proof of Prop. 5.2.4 has two real gaps, and the printed bounds still hold. (checked by `scripts/checks/proposition_5_2_4.py`).
